items.speaker_state: Vera is matter-of-factly explaining the tragedy. Her glance toward the open window connects the story to the room.
items.scene: Vera speaks in the room after Framton says he knows almost nothing about her aunt.
items.reaction_to_previous: She answers Framton's admission that he knows almost nothing about her aunt.
evidence: Vera glanced towards the French window, which stood wide open to the lawn.

items.speaker_state: Framton expresses sympathy for the loss Vera has described.
items.scene: Framton responds in the room after hearing Vera's account of the tragedy.
items.reaction_to_previous: He reacts to Vera's account of the family disappearing and their bodies never being found.
evidence: "They all disappeared. Their bodies were never found."

items.speaker_state: Vera speaks quietly about her aunt's continued expectation that the family will return.
items.scene: Vera speaks in the room after Framton expresses sympathy for the tragedy.
items.reaction_to_previous: She adds that her aunt still waits for the family to return.
evidence: "My aunt still thinks they'll come back."

items.speaker_state: The aunt sounds welcoming and speaks as though her husband and brothers will return soon.
items.scene: The aunt enters the room while Framton is with Vera and speaks before he can reply.
items.reaction_to_previous: She follows Vera's account of expecting to see them by speaking as if they are about to return.
evidence: "My husband and brothers will be back soon."
Before Framton could reply, her aunt hurried into the room.

items.speaker_state: The aunt appears pleased to see the returning men.
items.scene: The aunt looks toward the lawn and announces that the men have arrived.

items.speaker_state: The aunt matter-of-factly describes the visitor's sudden departure.
items.scene: After a returning man asks who the visitor was, the aunt answers him.
items.reaction_to_previous: She answers the man's question about the visitor.
evidence: "He talked about his nerves, then suddenly ran away."

items.speaker_state: Vera speaks calmly as she offers an explanation about the spaniel.
items.scene: Vera speaks after her aunt describes the visitor running away.
items.reaction_to_previous: She supplies an explanation for the visitor's sudden departure.
evidence: "He talked about his nerves, then suddenly ran away."

items.speaker_state: Vera calmly gives an account of Framton's fear of dogs and a past encounter.
items.scene: Vera speaks after saying the spaniel explains the visitor's departure.
items.reaction_to_previous: She expands on her explanation by describing his fear of dogs.
evidence: Inventing convincing stories at a moment's notice was Vera's speciality.
